senses.gloss:
mfn. (-चः-ची-चं)
Infernal, demoniacal, relating or belonging to a Piśāca or goblin.
m. (-चः)
A mode of marriage, the ravishment of a girl by her lover.
f. (-ची)
A present to a friend, or to secure friendly regard made at a religious ceremony.
E.
पिशाच an imp, aff. अण्.

n. (-नं)
1 Information, reporting evil of others.
2 Roguery.
E.
पिशुन a spy, &c. अण् aff.

n. (-न्यं)
1 Information, espionage, &c.
2 Depravity; wickedness.
E.
पिशुन a spy, a rogue, aff. यञ्.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टी-ष्टं)
Ground or made up into a cake.
f. (-ष्टी)
Spirituous liquor distilled from meal.
E.
पिष्ट ground, अण् aff.

n. (-कं)
1 A quantity of cakes.
2 Spirituous liquor distilled from meal.
E.
पिष्ट, and ठक् aff.
